korean_prompt: Tell me about a time you changed your approach based on feedback.
formal_expression: In my capstone project, feedback from my advisor changed how I evaluated our churn model.
casual_expression: My advisor's comment made me rethink how we measured our model.
answer_draft: In my capstone project, we built a model to predict which new customers would churn. At first, I only looked at accuracy. My advisor pointed out that coupons cost money, so different mistakes have different costs. I switched to evaluating recall together with coupon cost. As a result, targeting the top 20% of at-risk customers captured 71% of churners, and our simulation showed a 2.3x higher coupon response rate. I learned that a model is only useful when its metric matches the business's cost structure.
note: 졸업 프로젝트의 평가 기준 변경 경험을 STAR 순서로 정리했습니다.
evidence: experience.md > 고객 이탈 예측 졸업 프로젝트
